chunks: Ahmad b. Muhammad b. Yahya al-Attar (may Allah have mercy on him) narrated to us. He said: My father narrated to us, from Ja'far b. Muhammad al-Fazari, from Abbad b. Ya'qub, from Mansur b. Abi Nuwayra, from Abu Bakr b. Ayyash, from Abu Qudama al-Faddani. He said: The Messenger of Allah (may Allah bless him and his family) said:
Whoever is blessed by Allah with the recognition of my Ahl al-Bayt and their wilaya, then indeed Allah has gathered all goodness for him.

key_terms.الخير كله: All goodness — the totality of spiritual, moral, and worldly good gathered for one who upholds this recognition.
key_terms.معرفة أهل بيتي: Recognition of my Ahl al-Bayt — knowledge and acknowledgement of the Prophet's household and their spiritual station.
key_terms.ولايتهم: Their wilaya — allegiance, devotion, and acceptance of the spiritual authority of the Ahl al-Bayt.

ai.seo_question: What did the Prophet say about recognizing the Ahl al-Bayt and their wilaya?
ai.summary: This hadith from Abu Qudama al-Faddani records the Prophet's (s) statement that divine recognition of the Ahl al-Bayt and their wilaya is the key to all goodness, emphasizing that true knowledge of the Prophet's household is itself a divine blessing.
